voice.name: Open Sector - Jump Jet
voice.description: Male airborne trooper in his late twenties, cocky reckless daredevil with a grin you can hear, loud confident voice with a swaggering drawl, thrill-seeker who loves speed and height, laughs at danger, teasing and boastful, sounds like he is shouting over wind and engine roar.
voice.sample: Jump Jet here, and gravity is just a suggestion. Strap in, sir, I'll be over that wall before they even look up. Fuel's full, nerves are empty, let's fly!

fire.prompt: Short burst from a WWII assault rifle, three fast rounds, sharp cracks with short echo, close range outdoors, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Jet pack whoosh: short roaring thrust burst as a soldier leaps and glides through the air, rushing wind, close, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Jet pack ignition: click, hiss of fuel, then a powerful roaring rocket thrust launching upward and fading, close, outdoors, no music, no voice
